title: Inline Skills (+ why skills are not always better than tools or MCPs tokenwise)

cues.en: Hi, and welcome to another AI and C-Sharp video about Microsoft Agent Framework and something called Inline Skills.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎觀看另一支 Microsoft Agent Framework 的 C# AI 教學影片，今天介紹 Inline Skills。

cues.en: So we probably all know what skills are now, the kind of replacement for MCP servers and tools and stuff.
cues.zh: 現在大家應該都知道技能是什麼，常被視為 MCP 伺服器、工具等機制的替代方案。

cues.en: And of course, Microsoft Agent Framework supports skills.
cues.zh: Microsoft Agent Framework 當然支援技能。

cues.en: And I also made my own skills NuGet package that I've covered in previous videos.
cues.zh: 我自己也製作過技能 NuGet 套件，前面影片介紹過。

cues.en: But skills has always been seen as something that are in some folders.
cues.zh: 但技能一直被視為存放在資料夾中的內容。

cues.en: So you had a skill folder, you had some skills, and under the skill, you could have a skill MD file, which had some markdown,
cues.zh: 也就是有技能資料夾，裡面放一些技能，每個技能可以有 SKILL.md，包含 Markdown 指示，

cues.en: and then you had script references and other assets if you need it.
cues.zh: 再依需要加入指令碼、參考文件與其他素材。

cues.en: And in a previous video, I showed agent skills where I made some skills here with a small employee handbook.
cues.zh: 前一支影片中，我示範過 Agent Skills，建立了一份小型員工手冊技能。

cues.en: And we just loaded them up using a skill path here.
cues.zh: 只要在這裡提供技能路徑，就能載入。

cues.en: The old video was on the preview.
cues.zh: 舊影片使用的是預覽版本。

cues.en: The new one, I've updated a little because we need to disable approval from loading the skills.
cues.zh: 新版稍微更新，因為需要關閉載入技能時的核准機制。

cues.en: So I've just updated it.
cues.zh: 所以我調整了一下範例。

cues.en: But if I run that old sample here and ask, what are my benefits?
cues.zh: 如果執行舊範例，詢問「我有哪些福利？」。

cues.en: It is possible to use that skill.
cues.zh: 就能使用這個技能。

cues.en: And behind the scene, you can see that they actually turn into tool calls, and it can read the various files I have on my machine.
cues.zh: 背後可以看到，它們實際轉成工具呼叫，並讀取電腦上的各個檔案。

cues.en: And also notice that we roughly use around 1,700 input tools to do this.
cues.zh: 也請注意，這裡大約使用了 1,700 個輸入 Token。

cues.en: But what if your data that you want in skills actually come from a database or another system
cues.zh: 但如果技能資料其實來自資料庫或其他系統，

cues.en: or that you're, for some reason, are not allowed to have these files directly on the machine that actually runs your system?
cues.zh: 或是因為某些原因，不能直接把檔案放在執行系統的機器上呢？

cues.en: So there's another way, and that is inline skills.
cues.zh: 還有另一種方式，也就是 Inline Skills，內嵌技能。

cues.en: So let's go through those.
cues.zh: 接著看看。

cues.en: And then we'll talk a little about why I mentioned this 1,700 tokens as well.
cues.zh: 之後也會談談，為什麼剛剛特別提到那 1,700 個 Token。

cues.en: So apart from this, I also made a new sample down here called inline skills.
cues.zh: 除了前面的範例，我還新增了下面這個 Inline Skills 範例。

cues.en: Because agent framework can do this.
cues.zh: 因為 Agent Framework 支援這種做法。

cues.en: I haven't made this in my own agent skills NuGet package, and you will see the reason in a little while.
cues.zh: 我自己的技能 NuGet 套件沒有實作，稍後會看到原因。

cues.en: But what we do down here is we add some skills to a skill provider, just like we did in the previous video and what I just showed you.
cues.zh: 這裡和前一支影片、剛剛示範的做法相同，把技能加入 Skills Provider。

cues.en: But instead of pointing to a path, which we can do here, we can just give it some skills.
cues.zh: 但除了在這裡指定路徑，也可以直接提供技能物件。

cues.en: And in our case, we're giving it an employee handbook skill here.
cues.zh: 這個例子提供的是員工手冊技能。

cues.en: And you can just build up a skill in code.
cues.zh: 可以直接以程式碼建立技能。

cues.en: They're called agent inline skills, and you need to give it a name, a description, and the basic instructions,
cues.zh: 這個類型叫 AgentInlineSkill，需要提供名稱、描述，以及基本指示，

cues.en: meaning what is actually in the skills MD in the file version of this.
cues.zh: 也就是檔案版 SKILL.md 中的內容。

cues.en: There's a few other things you can set like license compatibility.
cues.zh: 另外可以設定授權條款、相容性等欄位。

cues.en: It's all metadata you can put on top of this.
cues.zh: 這些都是額外的中繼資料。

cues.en: But in a skill, you can then load up various resources.
cues.zh: 技能裡也能載入不同資源。

cues.en: So the other one we had underlying reference files here, and you can essentially mimic that using a resource.
cues.zh: 之前是底下的參考檔案，現在可以用資源模擬相同結構。

cues.en: It could even be an image and stuff.
cues.zh: 甚至也可以放入圖片等內容。

cues.en: And you can also add skill scripts.
cues.zh: 另外還能加入技能指令碼。

cues.en: So for example, we make a small remaining vacation in days, and we just turn it into a delegate here that returns 42 in this case.
cues.zh: 例如建立一個取得剩餘休假天數的功能，直接使用委派，這裡固定回傳 42。

cues.en: So this data is just hard-coded here, but of course, it could come from a database from any other place if need be.
cues.zh: 目前資料寫死在程式中，但當然也能視需求從資料庫或其他地方取得。

cues.en: And it works quite well.
cues.zh: 運作起來相當不錯。

cues.en: If I switch to that, we have done that, and we run it.
cues.zh: 切換到這個範例，設定好後執行。

cues.en: So we have something about what holidays we have.
cues.zh: 這裡有關於假日的資訊。

cues.en: What holidays do I have?
cues.zh: 例如詢問：我有哪些假日？

cues.en: And it will again use tools because again, behind the scenes skills are just tools that loads data on the fly.
cues.zh: 它一樣會使用工具，因為技能在背後就是透過工具，即時載入資料。

cues.en: And we can see it comes back with US holidays plus Christmas Eve is a full holiday.
cues.zh: 可以看到回覆美國國定假日，再加上聖誕夜全天放假。

cues.en: And that is because that's what we put in this resource that we have US public holidays plus Christmas Eve.
cues.zh: 原因是資源裡就是這樣設定：美國國定假日，加上聖誕夜。

cues.en: So on the fly, it read the employee handbook first, and then it read this specific part down here.
cues.zh: 它先即時讀取員工手冊，再讀取下面這個特定資源。

cues.en: And if we ask it,
cues.zh: 如果接著問，

cues.en: how many vacation days left?
cues.zh: 還剩幾天休假？

cues.en: It will then run a script in this case, and the script is just inline, and it will actually run the code we have, just like a tool would.
cues.zh: 這次就會執行指令碼。指令碼直接內嵌在程式裡，實際執行這段程式碼，就像一般工具。

cues.en: And we can see we roughly use the 1,200, 1,300 tokens.
cues.zh: 可以看到，大約使用 1,200 到 1,300 個 Token。

cues.en: And the only reason we use less tokens in this version is because up in the earlier version we had, where we just had a bit more information.
cues.zh: 這個版本比較省 Token，唯一原因是先前的版本有更多資訊。

cues.en: There was more data in these files and more skills than before.
cues.zh: 原本的檔案內容更多，技能數量也更多。

cues.en: More skills than before.
cues.zh: 也就是技能比現在更多。

cues.en: So now you might say, okay, I've heard that skills are better than tools and MTP servers,
cues.zh: 這時你可能會想，聽說技能比工具與 MCP 伺服器更好，

cues.en: and it's just much easier to do it like this
cues.zh: 而且這樣做更簡單，

cues.en: because we save a lot of tokens.
cues.zh: 因為可以省很多 Token。

cues.en: But you need to actually be a bit aware of what actually is going on.
cues.zh: 但必須先清楚實際發生了什麼事。

cues.en: Because, again, behind the scenes, it is tools.
cues.zh: 因為再次強調，背後仍然是工具。

cues.en: Whenever we make this skills provider behind the scenes in the context provider down here,
cues.zh: 建立 Skills Provider 時，下面的 Context Provider 在背後，

cues.en: it creates on the fly extra instructions in the system instructions,
cues.zh: 會即時把額外內容加入系統指示，

cues.en: and it creates some tools to do skill loading, read skill resource, and run skill, which is the three tools.
cues.zh: 並建立 LoadSkill、ReadSkillResource 與 RunSkill 這三個工具。

cues.en: So essentially, it's making three tools.
cues.zh: 所以本質上，是建立三個工具。

cues.en: And you can see that I'm turning on the raw calls so we can see those.
cues.zh: 我也開啟了原始呼叫記錄，方便觀察。

cues.en: And if I ask how many application days left, you will see that behind the scenes, it creates a tool called load skill,
cues.zh: 如果問還剩幾天休假，可以看到背後建立了一個 LoadSkill 工具，

cues.en: creates a tool called read skill resource, and it makes one called run skill script.
cues.zh: 一個 ReadSkillResource 工具，以及 RunSkillScript 工具。

cues.en: And then in our instructions, it creates information about our skills that we have put in.
cues.zh: 接著在指示中，加入我們提供的技能資訊。

cues.en: So this is something that happens behind the scenes using normal AI context provider features that we can do before, just before the AI runs.
cues.zh: 這使用的是一般 AI Context Provider 功能，在 AI 執行前處理。

cues.en: But what I want to show you and give you your attention
cues.zh: 但我想讓你特別注意的是，

cues.en: is that you might sit and say, oh, I have these old tools here.
cues.zh: 你可能會想，我現在用的這些舊工具，

cues.en: I should really get rid of them because then I can save a lot of tokens.
cues.zh: 應該趕快移除，這樣才能節省 Token。

cues.en: And that really, really depends.
cues.zh: 但這真的要看情況。

cues.en: Because if I give it as tools exactly the same information and get rid of the AI context provider here, so here I'm just making three tools,
cues.zh: 如果改用工具提供完全相同的資訊，移除 AI Context Provider，這裡只要建立三個工具，

cues.en: a leave tool, a holidays tool, and a vacation lift tool, which is essentially what I have here.
cues.zh: 分別是請假、假日與剩餘休假，和這裡的內容基本相同。

cues.en: I just don't need this little part up here.
cues.zh: 只是省掉上面這一小段。

cues.en: But beyond that, it can essentially do the same.
cues.zh: 除此之外，本質上能做相同的事情。

cues.en: This AI can do exactly the same as before, but now using tools instead.
cues.zh: AI 可以完成前面全部工作，只是改用工具。

cues.en: And we have heard that tools are bad and takes a lot of tokens.
cues.zh: 但大家都說，工具不好、很花 Token。

cues.en: So it should probably be much worse.
cues.zh: 所以結果應該差很多吧？

cues.en: How many vacation days do I have left?
cues.zh: 詢問：我還剩幾天休假？

cues.en: In this case, it of course makes my three tools as well and send the message and we get the response back and we get back that we had 42 vacation days left.
cues.zh: 這裡當然也會建立三個工具，送出訊息並取得回應，答案是還剩 42 天休假。

cues.en: But what you will notice is we only use 174 tokens, meaning one-tenth of what we just did with skills.
cues.zh: 但你會注意到，只使用了 174 個 Token，也就是剛剛技能版本的十分之一。

cues.en: And this is what many people don't understand.
cues.zh: 這就是很多人沒理解的地方。

cues.en: And this is not just because of its inline skills.
cues.zh: 而且不只是因為使用內嵌技能。

cues.en: All skills take up more time, including my skills that I may have made up in agents up here,
cues.zh: 各種技能都會有這些額外成本，包括我自己建立的技能套件，

cues.en: where I have my factory for skills as well.
cues.zh: 這裡也有自己的 Skills Factory。

cues.en: And we need to go to this one.
cues.zh: 切換到這個範例。

cues.en: So I have my own agent skills where we also give a folder here.
cues.zh: 這是我自己的 Agent Skills，一樣提供資料夾。

cues.en: We can try and run it.
cues.zh: 可以執行看看。

cues.en: What are my benefits?
cues.zh: 詢問：我有哪些福利？

cues.en: You can see it's also doing the same thing reading.
cues.zh: 可以看到，一樣會進行這些讀取操作。

cues.en: And again, it's reading a lot of extra tokens.
cues.zh: 同樣地，也花了不少額外 Token。

cues.en: So what in the world is going on?
cues.zh: 所以究竟發生了什麼事？

cues.en: People saying that skills are better, but apparently they are 10 times worse.
cues.zh: 大家說技能比較好，但看起來卻貴十倍。

cues.en: And that is because it very much depends on how many tools you have and how complex those tools are.
cues.zh: 原因是，這非常取決於工具數量與複雜度。

cues.en: In this case, they are very simple.
cues.zh: 這個例子的工具非常簡單。

cues.en: There are no input parameters.
cues.zh: 沒有任何輸入參數。

cues.en: The more input parameters, the more advanced those input parameters were.
cues.zh: 輸入參數越多、越複雜，

cues.en: The more upfront data is being used in order to load all three.
cues.zh: 預先載入所有工具定義所需的資料就越多。

cues.en: If I had 100 tools that I needed to add here, it will have cost more token because whenever you do tools,
cues.zh: 如果這裡有一百個工具，就會花更多 Token，因為使用工具時，

cues.en: tools are loaded upfront.
cues.zh: 定義會一開始就載入。

cues.en: In skills, they're not loaded upfront, but they are loaded with three tools, the read skill, the read resource, and the read script.
cues.zh: 技能則不會一開始載入完整內容，但需要三個工具：讀取技能、讀取資源，以及執行指令碼。

cues.en: And if those definitions of that are cost more than what the tools does, then it goes higher.
cues.zh: 如果這三個工具的定義成本，比原本那些工具更高，總用量就會增加。

cues.en: If you have so many tools and just need to...
cues.zh: 當你有很多工具，而且只需要其中一部分，

cues.en: And they are very, very complex down here, you begin to see a change in the scale.
cues.zh: 工具又非常複雜時，兩者的成本比例才會開始改變。

cues.en: But many people just begin to use skills and do the agent skills provider instead of tools.
cues.zh: 但很多人一開始就把工具改成 Skills Provider，

cues.en: And that is so bad to do in some cases.
cues.zh: 某些情況下，這其實是很差的選擇。

cues.en: Again, if I had 200 skills here, and some of them are very, very complex, we might become even.
cues.zh: 同樣地，如果這裡有兩百個技能，而且有些非常複雜，可能就會接近平衡。

cues.en: I haven't figured out the exact number because you can't really.
cues.zh: 我沒有找出確切數量，因為實際上很難有固定答案。

cues.en: Had I had a very complex object that the AI should fill out here, if this tool would cost more.
cues.zh: 如果工具要求 AI 填寫非常複雜的物件，它本身的定義成本就會更高。

cues.en: But in this case, I don't.
cues.zh: 但這個例子沒有。

cues.en: So like any other thing in coding, there is drawbacks and benefits to various things.
cues.zh: 所以和其他程式設計選擇一樣，不同做法各有優缺點。

cues.en: But skills have gotten this reputation of being much better.
cues.zh: 只是技能現在得到一種「一定更好」的名聲。

cues.en: And that is just one I wanted to show here in the end, not the case all the same at the time.
cues.zh: 這也是我最後想特別指出的：並不是每次都如此。

cues.en: But if you have a lot of data, and you don't want to make them as tools like this, because the tools could also have gotten the data
cues.zh: 如果資料很多，而且不想寫成這樣的工具，技能也可以使用。不過工具其實一樣能從，

cues.en: from a database or whatever.
cues.zh: 資料庫或其他地方取得資料。

cues.en: So they are also not having the issue of being files on the system.
cues.zh: 因此工具也沒有必須把資料放成系統檔案的限制。

cues.en: But it's a toss-up what is best in terms of data.
cues.zh: 所以資料如何提供，哪種比較好，仍然要視情況。

cues.en: So if you have a lot of skills and resources and stuff like that, it might at the end be better to do skills.
cues.zh: 如果有大量技能、資源等內容，最後可能使用技能更好。

cues.en: But it's not a surefire thing.
cues.zh: 但這不是必然的。

cues.en: In this case, going actually with the worst solution of using skills instead of just using three tools here.
cues.zh: 這個例子中，改用技能，反而比直接使用這三個工具更差。

cues.en: So again, I'm not saying I'm against skills.
cues.zh: 因此再次強調，我不是反對技能。

cues.en: Skills are an amazing thing, especially in coding harnesses and so on.
cues.zh: 技能非常棒，尤其適合程式開發代理程式等環境。

cues.en: But I'm a little less sure that it is the end-all be-all when it comes to C-Sharp.
cues.zh: 但在 C# 程式中，我不確定它是不是適合所有情境的萬靈丹。

cues.en: But again, now at least you know, and you also know that it is possible to do inline skills if need be.
cues.zh: 至少現在你知道這些取捨，也知道有需要時，可以使用內嵌技能。

cues.en: So with that, thank you. See you in the next one.
cues.zh: 感謝觀看，下一支影片見。
